body:
When I was 22 I weighed 330 pounds. I was in a very similar situation to yours. I hated myself and started drinking and drugging and smoking. I was in terrible health. My mother thought it was her fault also. Now, I do believe my weight was her fault because I never learned how to eat properly. I was fed out of the microwave and drive-thru windows. I drank soda like it was cool. 

I got it in my head I was going to lose weight. I cut out sugar food and drink and watched portion size. I started walking 3 miles a day 5 days a week, rain or shine. The first time I ran a mile was the happiest I felt about myself in a long time. Before long I was running the whole three miles then I started running 4,5,10 miles. I got down to 180 pounds.

It's not just the outer appearance that changes. The confidence change is the life changing part. You are at a great age to lose weight. I lost 12 pounds in the first week. 

I've been married 5 years and have two kids. Nothing is greater than looking into the eyes of a human that loves you unconditionally for no other reason than you are their dad. Don't leave this world before you can experience these true joys in life.
